source_policy: Prefer repo evidence, official docs, standards bodies, and established science sources.

sources.phase_use: Use v320 completion as the handoff floor.
Use sibling rules, watcher state, and staging boundaries.
Keep the app heartbeat as the thread-context wake layer.
Treat partial lid closure as a host power-state risk before blaming repo automation.
Keep MCP/API expansion behind explicit trust boundaries.
Keep workflow and token handling conservative.
Govern, map, measure, and manage risk as the phase expands.
Keep human dignity and rights visible in synthesis language.
Anchor Freed ID discussions in portable credential standards.
Separate established physics from metaphoric GMUT synthesis.

sources.topic: NASA dark matter and dark energy
sources.phase_use: Keep cosmology unknowns honest.
Treat Codex as the agentic coding command center, not as proof of unattended success.
Keep future API calls stateful, auditable, and explicitly scoped.
Separate agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, and sessions.
Keep trustworthy AI tied to human rights, democratic values, and accountability.
Preserve risk-based governance and human oversight in system claims.
Treat theory-of-everything synthesis as exploratory until mathematical and empirical bridges exist.
Treat future hardware as acceleration, not a prerequisite for repo correctness.
Keep simulation and digital-twin ideas as optional validation layers.
Use high-bandwidth interconnects as an analogy for explicit handoff channels.
Keep edge deployment exploratory until secrets and scope are explicit.
Use database branch and MCP actions only after credentials, rollback, and scope are clear.
Keep CI secrets in restricted contexts and avoid leaking them into logs.
Treat hosted agent deployment as future scoped infrastructure, not current implicit access.
